svg.title: Mainframe — computer cabinet robot
svg.desc: A steel blue robot whose body is a tall 1960s computer cabinet with two tape reels behind a window and a panel of yellow and cyan lights, a small square head with two round eyes and a short antenna, ring jointed arms with three finger hands, and short legs on flat feet.
